files.ontology:
@prefix tm: <urn:todaymath:vocab:> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

tm:ContentEntity a owl:Class .
tm:TextbookConcept a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:ContentEntity .
tm:CourseSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:ContentEntity .
tm:RegisteredEntity a owl:Class .
tm:Assertion a owl:Class .
tm:partOf a owl:ObjectProperty, owl:TransitiveProperty ;
  rdfs:domain tm:ContentEntity ; rdfs:range tm:ContentEntity .
tm:covers a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:projectsSourceSection a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:directPedagogicalPrerequisite a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:supports a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:observedIn a owl:ObjectProperty .

tm:SourceEntity a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:RegisteredEntity .
tm:SourceGrade a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceChapter a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceDefinition a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceAssessmentEntry a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceQuestionRepresentation a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceLearningUnit a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceCard a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceRecallGroup a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceEditorialUnit a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceEditorialTopic a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceCourse a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceCourseExpression a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceSkill a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceGeneratorFamily a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceRequirement a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceTeachingScript a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceScriptTurn a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceSourceReference a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceLabUnit a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceSourceQuestion a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity, tm:ContentEntity .
tm:SourceOfficialStandard a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .
tm:SourceOperationalModel a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:SourceEntity .

  "profile": "tm-owlrl-1",

    "rdfs:subClassOf",
